content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBBS from any recognised Universities; MD in Radio Diagnosis or equivalent from any recognised Medical Institutes; Permanent registration with West Bengal Medical Council Experience: Minimum one (01) year experience after passing MD/Equivalent Examination is desirable. Age limit: Maximum 45 years Other conditions: Preferably residing in West Bengal Desirable: Minimum one (01) year experience after passing MD/Equivalent Examination

content_sections.heading: Visva-Bharati Radiologist Job Description
content_sections.text: Perform duties on a part-time basis for a session of 03 (Three) hours daily for 06 (six) days in a week. Duties as assigned by the Authority.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Engaged purely on contract basis initially for a period of six months Contract service may be extended from time to time provided Authority is satisfied

content_sections.heading: How Will Visva-Bharati Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Short-listing of candidates Interview through Email I.D. Only short-listed candidates will be called for the interview through their Email I.D.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self attested Aadhaar Birth Certificate or Proof of age Educational Qualifications (Self attested copies of Madhyamik, HS, MBBS, MD/Equivalent) West Bengal Medical Council Registration No. (Self attested copy) Experience proof Self-attested passport size coloured photograph

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Visva-Bharati Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application format in Annexure - I. Attach self-attested copies of Aadhaar, Birth Certificate, Educational Qualifications, West Bengal Medical Council Registration No., and Experience proof. Affix self-attested passport size coloured photograph. Reach the application to the office of the Chief Medical Officer, Pearson Memorial Hospital, Visva-Bharati, Santiniketan before 5:00 p.m. on 20.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Nature of duty is as assigned by the Authority.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Visva-Bharati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Visva-Bharati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Radiologist.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Visva-Bharati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure - I) and send it to Office of the Chief Medical Officer, Pearson Memorial Hospital, Visva-Bharati, Santiniketan, Birbhum, PIN-731235, by by post or in person, to reach by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 75,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS with MD in Radio Diagnosis or equivalent and permanent registration with West Bengal Medical Council.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Preferably residing in West Bengal.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Short-listing of candidates. Interview through Email I.D. Only short-listed candidates will be called for the interview through their Email I.D.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engaged purely on contract basis initially for a period of six months. Contract service may be extended from time to time provided Authority is satisfied.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Santiniketan.
